solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Religious teacher and Edward informally talked

parts.note: a rabbi is a Jewish religious teacher
Ted is a familiar short form of Edward

explanation.surface: A rabbi and a man called Edward had a casual chat.
explanation.walkthrough: To rabbit (on) is British slang for talking at length.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang to rabbit is to chatter on, so the past tense means chattered or talked.

clue.text: Would-be revolutionary partisan

indicators.note: the letters of partisan are overturned into a new order

parts.note: anagram fodder, used as written

explanation.surface: A wannabe rebel who backs one side.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspirant is someone hoping to achieve a position, like a hopeful or a wannabe.

clue.text: Nothing to wear for annual event?

definitions.meaning: a humorous phrase for being naked
the outfit is literally read as clothing for one's yearly celebration

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests panic over a party outfit; the answer is nakedness, as on the day you were born.
explanation.definitionFit: Birthday suit is a jocular idiom for bare skin, how people arrive at birth.

clue.text: King's supporter, it's said, no longer in the saddle

indicators.note: the word for the royal seat sounds like the answer when spoken

parts.note: a king sits on, and is held up by, a throne

explanation.surface: A monarch's backer has been unhorsed.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider who has been thrown has been unseated and has fallen from the horse.

clue.text: Finally, crowd outside film studio cut short protest

indicators.note: the final letter of each of the four words is taken

parts.note: the last letters of these four words are read in order

explanation.surface: A crowd outside a film studio has its protest curtailed.
explanation.walkthrough: Cut short reads as wordplay on the studio but belongs to the definition: the word is demonstration abbreviated.
explanation.definitionFit: Demo is a shortened informal form of demonstration, a public march or rally.

clue.text: Move up the right men, though lacking leaders

indicators.note: lacking leaders means each of the three words loses its first letter

explanation.surface: Promote the right people, even if they have no one in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop the first letters T, R and M from THE, RIGHT and MEN; 'though' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To heighten is to raise or increase, so to lift something higher.

clue.text: Where to find Nicaraguan or Guatemalan, or old Peruvian

parts.note: where you would find someone is the place they are in
both are Central American, abbreviated CA

explanation.surface: A puzzle about where Latin Americans live.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as IN CA: in Central America.
explanation.definitionFit: The Incas were the native people ruling the Andean empire centred on Peru before the Spanish conquest.

clue.text: Article about one extremely dishonest activity

indicators.note: the article goes around the one

parts.note: the is the definite article
very means to an extreme degree

explanation.surface: A news story about a person who is thoroughly crooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Thievery is the practice of stealing, a criminal and dishonest pursuit.

clue.text: Coming out of hotel, even though it's after ten

indicators.note: the answer emerges from inside the run of words that follows, spanning their boundaries

parts.note: the letters run from the end of hotel through even into though

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a hotel even though it is past ten o'clock at night.
explanation.definitionFit: In any ordinal sequence the eleventh position comes immediately after the tenth one.

clue.text: Part of rigging fight

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a pole such as a mast or boom on a ship
second meaning: to box or argue

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a rigged fight, but the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names a ship's pole holding sails, and the verb means to box in practice or bicker.

clue.text: Demolished hot unrefined food in street

indicators.note: something demolished is knocked down and rebuilt, so these three letters are rearranged

parts.note: anagram fodder, used as written
rough means crude or unpolished
fare is food provided, as in a menu's bill of fare

explanation.surface: Someone wolfed down hot, coarse food out on the street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Demolished' reads as eaten greedily, but it rearranges the word hot.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoroughfare is a main road or public way through a place, a synonym for a street.

clue.text: Checking under normal conditions big game bagged by novelist

indicators.note: the game is put in a bag made of the novelist's name

parts.note: Henry Fielding wrote Tom Jones
a Test is a full international cricket match

explanation.surface: A writer bags some big game on a hunt.
explanation.walkthrough: Big game suggests hunting trophies; it is a cricket Test match.
explanation.definitionFit: Field-testing is trialling a product in real-world use rather than a laboratory.

clue.text: Shrub needing drainage badly

indicators.note: the letters of drainage are put together badly, meaning jumbled into a new order

parts.note: anagram fodder, used as written

explanation.surface: A plant that suffers in soil with poor drainage.
explanation.definitionFit: The gardenia is an evergreen flowering bush with fragrant white blooms.

clue.text: Legendary weightlifter collected world records?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the Titan of Greek myth who bore the heavens on his shoulders
second meaning: a book of maps recording the world

explanation.walkthrough: World records suggests sporting feats to go with the weightlifter, but it means maps.
explanation.definitionFit: The Titan condemned to hold up the sky gave his name to bound volumes of maps.

clue.text: Highest number on clock in taxi indicated?

definitions.meaning: the top figure on a clock face
the letters XI I run through taxi indicated, the Roman numeral for that number

explanation.surface: A passenger glances at the clock and the taxi meter.
explanation.walkthrough: The Roman numeral XII sits in taXI Indicated, the form many clock faces print at the top.
explanation.definitionFit: Clock faces run from one to twelve, which is placed at the top of the dial.

clue.text: Guy's instruction to boxer, perhaps

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a guy is a supporting rope
second meaning: a command to a dog, a boxer being a breed

explanation.walkthrough: The boxer is a dog breed, not a fighter, and the guy is a rope, not a man.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay is a rope bracing a mast, like a guy rope, and a word ordering a dog not to move.

clue.text: Where ministers could have learnt from poor miner, say

indicators.note: the letters of miner and say are put in a poor, disordered state

parts.note: anagram fodder, both words used as written

explanation.surface: Clergy might have picked up lessons from a struggling mineworker.
explanation.definitionFit: A seminary is a college where priests and clergy are trained for the ministry.

clue.text: Look inside to study this part of body

indicators.note: the word for look is placed within the word for study

parts.note: to con is to study or learn carefully
lo is an old exclamation meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: A doctor peers inside a patient to examine an organ.
explanation.definitionFit: The colon is the main section of the large intestine, an organ of the digestive tract.

clue.text: Complaint over game in wintry spell

indicators.note: in a down clue the illness sits above the game

parts.note: a cold is a minor illness, a complaint
snap is a children's card game

explanation.surface: A minor illness after a match played in cold weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold snap is a short sudden period of cold weather.

clue.text: Reversed a few feet in cart

indicators.note: the measure is written back to front

parts.note: a yard is three feet

explanation.surface: A driver backs a cart up a short distance.
explanation.definitionFit: A dray is a low heavy cart without sides, traditionally used for carrying beer barrels.

clue.text: Scary weapon seen in a catalogue

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the weapon appears within a and the catalogue

parts.note: a list is a catalogue of items
an arm is a weapon

explanation.surface: A frightening gun listed in a sales catalogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarmist describes something that needlessly spreads fear or panic.

clue.text: Given and returned, coming back in fall, autumn

indicators.note: the hidden letters are then read from right to left
the letters are found inside the words fall and autumn

parts.note: the letters straddle the end of fall and the start of autumn

explanation.surface: Someone returns in autumn, also known as the fall.
explanation.walkthrough: Fall is the American word for autumn, which makes the pairing look like a gloss.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutual feelings are felt by each party toward the other, offered and reciprocated.

clue.text: It's used by typist, but not for letters

definitions.meaning: a key pressed constantly by anyone typing
pressing it produces a gap between words rather than any letter

explanation.walkthrough: Letters suggests correspondence a typist might write, but it means the characters of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: The long key at the bottom of a keyboard inserts a blank space instead of a character.

clue.text: Old answer covering new business items

indicators.note: the word for old wraps around the abbreviation for new

parts.note: aged means old

explanation.surface: An outdated reply covering fresh matters of commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is the list of matters to be discussed at a meeting.

clue.text: Sacred books we sent out, getting positive response time after time

indicators.note: the letters of we sent are put out of order

parts.note: anagram fodder, used as written
amen is a response of assent to a prayer

explanation.surface: Someone mails out religious books and gets a warm reply again and again.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Testament is the second part of the Christian Bible, a collection of scriptures.

clue.text: Source for four-letter word repeated in Shakespeare comedy

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a spring or water source

definitions.text: four-letter word repeated in Shakespeare comedy
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the word that appears twice in All's ___ That Ends ___

explanation.walkthrough: Four-letter word hints at a swear word, but it is simply a word of four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A well is a spring of water, and it appears twice in the title All's Well That Ends Well.

clue.text: A royal I revered, ultimately, inspired with respect

parts.note: taken as written
the royal we is the plural a monarch uses for I

indicators.note: only the last letter of revered is taken

parts.note: its last letter is the one used

explanation.surface: A monarch says how deeply revered they were.
explanation.definitionFit: Being awed means filled with wonder and reverential respect.

clue.text: Pupil is at the centre of this bloomer

definitions.text: Pupil is at the centre of this
definitions.meaning: first meaning: the coloured ring of the eye, with the pupil in its middle
second meaning: a flowering plant, the flag

explanation.walkthrough: Pupil suggests a schoolchild and bloomer a blunder, but these are the eye and a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The coloured ring around the eye's pupil shares its name with a garden flower.

clue.text: Downgrade, for example, when included in recount

indicators.note: the abbreviation is placed within the word for recount

parts.note: to relate is to tell or recount a story

explanation.surface: A vote is reduced in status during a recount.
explanation.definitionFit: To relegate is to demote, as a football team sent down to a lower division.

clue.text: Lots of fish caught for men on board

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a draught is a single haul of fish in a net
second meaning: the pieces of the board game checkers

explanation.walkthrough: Men on board suggests sailors, but the board is a games board. Draughts is the British name for checkers.
explanation.definitionFit: A draught is a catch of fish in one net, and the plural is also the game played with checkers pieces.
